scripts.build:arch: npm run build:bin && cp src-tauri/target/release/gitfusion pkg/ && cd pkg && makepkg -f
scripts.build:appimage: NO_STRIP=true tauri build --bundles appimage || bash scripts/appimage-fallback.sh
scripts.build:linux: npm run build:arch && npm run build:deb-rpm && npm run build:appimage && npm run collect:release
scripts.collect:release: mkdir -p release && cp pkg/*.pkg.tar.zst src-tauri/target/release/bundle/deb/*.deb src-tauri/target/release/bundle/rpm/*.rpm src-tauri/target/release/bundle/appimage/*.AppImage release/
